requirements.name: google-sign-in
requirements.description: Replaces Google sign-in: the Sign in button opens a picker over the seeded players, and choosing one signs the demo in as that player.

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
requirements.description: OAuth client ID for Google sign-in

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
requirements.description: OAuth client secret for Google sign-in

requirements.name: google-redirect-uri
requirements.description: Redirect URI must be registered before sign-in works
requirements.instructions: Add {{deploy_url}}/auth/google/callback to Authorized redirect URIs for the OAuth client.

requirements.name: pickup-pacing
requirements.description: How fast Power-Ups pickups spawn and how long their effects last: chaotic, fair or dull is only judged by playing it.

requirements.name: where-the-effect-badge-sits
requirements.description: Where the active Power-Ups effects and their countdowns are shown without covering the ball or the mode badge at bottom-left.

requirements.name: slow-mo
requirements.description: Whether the Slow-Mo pickup (slows the ball to about half speed for a few seconds) is among the pickups in the Power-Ups fun mode.

requirements.name: ghost-ball
requirements.description: Whether the Ghost Ball pickup (makes the ball semi-transparent and flicker for a few seconds while still colliding normally) is among the pickups in the Power-Ups fun mode.
